v: strI purIM dehaM tanoti tana--kvip । 1 dehAramBake (A~ta) antrAKye nAqIBede । puri dehe tanoti AcCAdayati hfdayAdi aluksa॰ hrasvamaDyaH । 2 hfdayAcCAdake mAMsaBede yaju॰ 39 । 9 dIrGapAWaH anyatra hrasvapAWaH । 3 dehe ca “yadA supto na kaYcana veda hitA nAma nAqyo dvAsaptatiH sahasrARi hfdayAt purItatamamipratizWante tABiH pratyavasfpya purItati Sete” Sata॰ brA॰ 145 । 1 । 21 “yasmin kAle jAgratsvapnayordrazwA darSanavftti svapnaM hitvA suzuptaH viSezajYAnABAvena samprasAdasvasvarUpaM brahmEkyaM gato Bavati । hfdayaM nAmodaravakzaHpradeSayormaDyasTitaH puRqarIkAkAro mAMsapiRqastatparivezwanaM purItadityucyate iha punastadupalakzitaM SarIraM purItacCabdenABipretam । taTA ca hfdayAt purItataM SarIramaBipratizWanta iti kftsnaM SarIraM vyApnuvantyo'SvatTaM parRarAjaya iva bahirmuKAH aBito niHsaranti । tABirvAqIBiH kftvA jAgradvimayAyA budDeH karmavaSAt patyavasarpaRamanu vijYAnamaya AtmA pratyavasfpyendriyARyupasaMhftya purItati Sete agnivat taptaM lohapiRqamaviSezeRa saMvyApya varttate” BA॰
